editedExercise.name: Dolphin Push-Up

instructions.description: Start in a downward-facing position with your hands shoulder-width apart, your legs extended, and your hips lifted high. Keep your arms straight and your core engaged.
Bend your elbows and slowly lower your upper body while moving your head toward the floor between your hands. Keep your hips lifted and your body controlled throughout the movement.
Press firmly through your hands and straighten your arms to push your upper body back up. Return to the starting position with your hips lifted.
Repeat the movement slowly and with control, keeping your core engaged and avoiding excessive movement through your lower back.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count repetitions completed with controlled technique.

commentsNotes: Keep your hips high throughout the exercise rather than dropping them toward the floor.
Move your head forward and down between your hands as you lower yourself.
Keep your elbows controlled and avoid letting them flare excessively to the sides.
Engage your core and legs to maintain a stable position.
If your mobility is limited, don't force your head toward the floor — work within a comfortable range of motion.
